scopes.name: Connecting Ridge Convex Anti-Earth Slope Traverse (Primary Validated Baseline)
scopes.provenance: Anchored at Connecting Ridge ROI (De Rosa et al. 2012 Table 2, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1208.5587#page=55); elevations sampled from LOLA 80 m/px DEM LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ.TIF in MOON_ME_DE421.
scopes.terrainRegime: Moderate convex ridge slope (-30.4 m vertical drop over 753 m chord; -1.59 m chord clearance for a 15 m mast, +2.42 m clearance for a 30 m mast) during C2 southern apolune pass.

scopes.name: Shackleton Rim Steep Outer-Flank Defilade Traverse
scopes.provenance: Anchored at Shackleton Rim ROI (De Rosa et al. 2012 Table 2, lat=-89.7755 deg, lon=-156.4480 deg, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1208.5587#page=55); elevations sampled from LOLA 80 m/px DEM LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ.TIF in MOON_ME_DE421.
scopes.terrainRegime: Steep convex crater-rim flank (-105.9 m vertical drop over 1,137 m chord; min chord clearance -23.26 m for a 15 m mast and -5.35 m even for a 60 m mast), representing severe terrain defilade where surface towers cannot close line of sight.

scopes.name: de Gerlache Rim Saddle Traverse During Single-Relay Perilune Handover
scopes.provenance: Anchored at de Gerlache Rim ROI (De Rosa et al. 2012 Table 2, lat=-88.6952 deg, lon=-68.2846 deg, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1208.5587#page=55); elevations sampled from LOLA 80 m/px DEM LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ.TIF in MOON_ME_DE421.
scopes.terrainRegime: Rim saddle traverse (-60.1 m vertical drop over 555 m westward chord) coinciding with C2's northern-hemisphere perilune occultation (t=464,400-471,600 s) and C4's RELAY_2 -> RELAY_1 south-pole handover.
